meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体框架装好命令行网关,并恢复运行、审批与设置配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在给智能体框架接入新的网关组件,需要一次装好并恢复运行配置。
copy.tagline_en: Install a CLI gateway into your agent framework and restore runtime and approval setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're wiring a new gateway into your agent framework and need it installed and running.

howto.what: 把 OneCLI 装成 NanoClaw 的网关提供方:复制适配器、测试与代理指引到 NanoClaw 对应路径,注册 provider,安装 @onecli-sh/sdk@2.2.1,配置网关,再跑构建与测试。
howto.when: 当安装流程选择 OneCLI、已有 OneCLI 安装要迁移到网关接缝,或需要恢复其运行时、审批桥与设置时,由该技能接管。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider: copies adapter files, tests and agent guidance, registers the provider, installs @onecli-sh/sdk@2.2.1, configures the gateway, then runs build and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when setup selects OneCLI, when an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or when its runtime, approval bridge and setup must be restored from the in-tree package.

say_en.text: Install OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider
say_en.note: Copies provider files and runs the install script

say_en.text: Install OneCLI with a remote gateway; host and token come from env vars
Refresh the existing OneCLI install and run its tests
say_en.note: Reuses a healthy install, then builds and tests
